name: Nichireki Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Nichireki Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of applied and processed asphalt products in Japan. The company offers applied and processed asphalt products, including asphalt emulsions, modified asphalt, bridge deck waterproofing materials, road surface repairing materials, crack repairing materials, landscape paving materials, and industrial products, as well as involved in the manufacturing, processing, and sale of construction and civil engineering materials. It also provides contracting services for road paving; bridge deck waterproofing; water and sewage; and other civil engineering works, such as relevant survey and diagnosis, design, and administration process solution…
